notes: TWO PANELS. The sheet is a long strip drawn in two pieces separated by a heavy double line at y~2880-2930. The UPPER panel (y<~2900, all points marked part 'inset') is the WEST end of the strip: Burnet Woods Park / Calhoun / McMillan from West Clifton Avenue east past Hartshorn to Calhoun 229-230 / McMillan 114; it is drawn out of place (it really lies west of the lower panel's left edge, where the lower panel prints '260' at Calhoun). The LOWER panel (no part field) is in place: W. Corry at the top (meeting Hopson, Pecan and Dennis from sheet 261), Claassen, Dennis, Scioto, Calhoun 225-101, Ohio Avenue and McMillan 112-36. Printed names: 'W. CLIFTON AV.', 'CALHOUN', 'HARTSHORN', 'W. McMILLAN', 'W. CORRY', 'HOPSON', 'PECAN', 'DENNIS', 'SCIOTO', 'CLAASSEN', 'OHIO AV.'; suffix-less names written with 'Street'. UPPER: West Clifton's west line is lost in the gutter (the 259 page curls into it); its centre is from the east line (x~533-537) minus half the printed 72' (same junctions as 259's West Clifton/Calhoun and West Clifton/McMillan). West Clifton ends at Calhoun (T). Hartshorn is 42' at Calhoun and 50' at McMillan (west line steps); it continues north of Calhoun as a 50' street (x~1984-2264) to the park line (end recorded), so Hartshorn/Calhoun is a cross; nothing continues south of McMillan (241 block), T. McMillan's south line runs into the panel border; centre taken between its north line (y~2533-2549) and the border, matching the midpoint of its two water pipes (10" and 36"). LOWER: West Corry (60') runs from the park (west end recorded) east off the panel edge onto 262. Hopson (~32', x~1189-1383) and Pecan (diagonal, from NNW) come down from 261 and end at Corry (T). The diagonal 40' street from 261 (the water pipe runs on through) meets Corry ~130 px west of the N-S 40' DENNIS that continues south; following 263 the diagonal is 'Dennis Street (south of Daniels)' and the N-S piece here is named 'Dennis Street (south of Corry)'; two T points on Corry. Scioto (60') crosses Corry, Claassen and Calhoun and ends at McMillan (T; key map shows no street south of it). Claassen is 20' west of Scioto (centre y~4670-4705) and ~30' east of it (centre ~4633); the Scioto/Claassen point is the mean. Calhoun is 50' at the west end of the lower panel and 60' from x~1150 east. Ohio Avenue (60') runs from Calhoun (T, the Calhoun-front block 202-142 covers its line to the north) south across McMillan (its water pipes continue south: cross). McMillan centres are from the north line plus half of 60'. An unnamed 10' alley runs from Calhoun to McMillan at x~1830, and an unnamed 5' alley runs east from x~1183 to it at y~6823 (inside block 4). Circled figures are grade elevations; the big red circle in Scioto at Calhoun is a fire-alarm/engine symbol.
